name: Dhaka Metropolitan Police — thanas and official numbers
attribution: Dhaka Metropolitan Police (dmp.gov.bd); Deputy Commissioner's office, Dhaka (dhaka.gov.bd)
notes: No licence stated. Only institutional numbers are collected: duty-officer T&T landlines, OC official mobiles, fax and PABX extensions (extra_json), @dmp.gov.bd / @police.gov.bd e-mails, the Commissioner post's office numbers and the control room. Inspector-investigation mobiles and officers' names are not copied. The 'Find Your Local Police' list is undated; many landlines are in the old 7-digit format. No thana is placed in DNCC or DSCC (area_en empty): no official thana-to-city-corporation list was found.
